verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Apify's Actor marketplace, SDKs, CLI, and MCP integration for AI agents, but contains no documentation of a natural-language-to-structured-data extraction capability (e.g., prompt-based field extraction without selectors). Apify's tooling described here still relies on Actors/code (Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, Crawlee) rather than NL-driven extraction.
